# FOX6 News Milwaukee

> > FOX6 News Milwaukee (WITI) delivers breaking news, weather forecasts, sports coverage, and live streaming across multiple platforms for the Wisconsin community.

FOX6 News Milwaukee is the local NBC affiliate serving the Milwaukee and Wisconsin region, providing comprehensive coverage of breaking news, severe weather alerts, Milwaukee sports teams, and community programming. The station offers multi-platform access including live streaming on Roku, Apple TV, and Amazon Fire TV.
